author: ToolUp Analytics Ltd (UK)
name: ToolUp Platform SDK Data Platform
description: A grounded data platform as a whole repository: a RAG application with the fact tier, an upload-fed data module whose outputs are fact tables, a model-written daily report whose every number is a Fact, and audience-gated report pages on the same pipeline. Ships synthetic data and an end-to-end test.

port-server.description: Server port. Must not clash with any port already bound on the dev machine; tools/ToolUp.PortGuard (run via templates/New-ToolUpApp.ps1) can scan an adjacent app tree and reject clashing values.

port-client-vite.description: Vite dev-server port. Same clash-rejection contract as --port-server.

sdk-version.description: ToolUp.* SDK version. Drives every ToolUp.* pin through $(ToolUpSdkVersion) in Directory.Packages.props.

feed.description: Folder feed added as an extra restore source in nuget.config, for unreleased ToolUp.* packs. The only machine-shaped path in the generated repository; delete the `local` source if you consume released versions only.

manualInstructions.text: Run `pwsh ./run.ps1`: format check, build, and the end-to-end test over the synthetic data.
Run `pwsh ./run.ps1 -Run` to start the server, then upload data/sample/daily-trade.synthetic.csv; README.md walks through it.
